messages.quote: Gaji bulanan Anda naik menjadi IDR 42750000. Perubahan ini berlaku mulai 2025-08-15.
messages.summary: Employer Cobalt Systems raises the user's regular monthly salary to IDR 42,750,000 effective 2025-08-15.

messages.quote: Gaji rutin untuk penggajian berikutnya sudah dikonfirmasi. Slip gaji berikutnya akan menampilkan gaji rutin dan penyesuaian satu kali secara terpisah.
messages.summary: Employer BrightPath Media confirms the regular salary for the next payroll; the next payslip will show the regular salary and a one-time adjustment separately. No amounts or dates are given, so only the regular salary (unchanged) stands and the one-time adjustment is not a regular amount.

messages.quote: Bonus kuartalan Anda masih menunggu hasil akhir penilaian kinerja. Jumlah akhir dan tanggal pembayaran belum disetujui.
messages.summary: Employer states the quarterly bonus is still pending performance review; amount and payment date are not yet approved, so the bonus credit is unconfirmed and must not be counted.

messages.quote: Your temporary monthly pay is EUR 1037.52. The reduced amount continues for the next payroll.
messages.summary: Employer Northstar Labs states temporary reduced monthly pay of EUR 1037.52 continues for the next payroll cycle; no date given.

messages.quote: Your confirmed salary is now expected on 2024-09-23. This replaces the payroll date shown in the earlier update.
messages.summary: Employer BrightPath Media moved the confirmed salary payment date to 2024-09-23, superseding any earlier payroll date; no amount change stated.

messages.quote: Your next salary is reduced to EUR 1422.85. The adjustment is due to approved unpaid leave.
messages.summary: Employer states the user's next salary is reduced to EUR 1422.85 due to approved unpaid leave; no date given, stream continues.

messages.quote: The next QuickCrew payout is still pending. The weekly earnings shown in the QuickCrew app can change until the payout is closed. The balance isn’t withdrawable until the payout shows as completed.
messages.summary: QuickCrew gig platform says the next payout is still pending, earnings figures may change, and the balance is not withdrawable until completed — the gig income is unconfirmed/not available; no amount or date given.

messages.quote: Gaji pokok yang dikonfirmasi adalah IDR 38760000. Komisi dari transaksi yang masih berjalan belum disetujui. Transaksi yang masih berjalan tidak masuk pembayaran sampai komisinya dinyatakan diperoleh.
messages.summary: Employer confirms regular base salary of IDR 38,760,000; commission on pending deals is not approved and will not be paid until earned, so no commission income should be counted.

messages.quote: The current seasonal contract has ended. No off-season income or renewal has been confirmed.
messages.summary: Employer Cobalt Systems states the seasonal contract has ended with no confirmed off-season income or renewal; the salary income stream ends as of 2026-03-25 and no future credit is confirmed.

messages.quote: Regular salary of EUR 2717 resumes on 2025-08-15.
messages.summary: Employer confirms regular salary of EUR 2717 resumes on 2025-08-15; a new recurring childcare payment/deduction starts the same month but no amount is given.

messages.quote: Your first salary will be EUR 1661. The confirmed credit date is 2026-01-15.
messages.summary: Employer Riverline Retail confirms the user's first salary of EUR 1661 crediting on 2026-01-15.

messages.quote: The renewed lease increases monthly rent by 12%. The new amount will be used for the next rent payment.
messages.summary: Service provider (StayLedger) states the renewed lease raises monthly rent by 12%, applying from the next rent payment; no absolute amount or date given.

messages.quote: The matching debit and credit came from a transfer between your two accounts. Both accounts are registered under the same account holder.
messages.summary: Bank confirms the matching debit/credit pair is an internal transfer between the user's own accounts (ref BAN-0013), so the credit is not income.

messages.quote: Your refund has been initiated but has not reached your account yet. We’ll send another update when the credit is completed.
messages.summary: Merchant CartLane says the refund (event_1785, INR 8640) is initiated but not yet credited; the credit remains pending/unconfirmed with no new date given.

messages.quote: Your portfolio’s displayed market value has increased substantially. No units have been sold and no cash proceeds have been generated.
messages.summary: ClearFund reports the portfolio's displayed market value rose, but no units were sold and no cash proceeds exist. The valuation remains unrealised and non-cash; no spendable income is confirmed and no amount/date change applies to event_1960.

messages.quote: Your prize claim has been verified and is still in payment processing. The payment has not been credited to your account yet. We’ll confirm again if and when the money is actually credited.
messages.summary: DrawPay says the prize payment is still in processing and not yet credited; the credit remains unconfirmed. No amount, date or instruction given.

messages.quote: The prize proceeds have reached your account after withholding. The claim is now closed and there are no further scheduled payments.
messages.summary: PrizeTrack confirms the one-time prize proceeds (event_2165, INR 33,550) settled; claim closed with no further scheduled payments, so no recurring income arises.
